PRU Vantage Wealth II is an Investment-Linked Plan (ILP) which invests in ILP sub-fund(s). Investment products are subject to investment risks including the possible loss of the principal amount invested. The

performance of the ILP sub-fund(s) is not guaranteed and the value of the units and the income accruing to the units (if any) may fall or rise. Past performance is not necessarily indicative of future performance.

If you choose an ILP sub-fund that aims to distribute dividends on a regular basis, please note that the distribution of dividends are at the discretion of the underlying fund’s Board of Directors, Manager and/or

Prudential Singapore, and is not guaranteed. The distribution of dividends may be effectively paid out of capital, which will reduce the net asset value of the fund which is used to calculate the fund’s unit price
and the surrender value of the policy.
